set.t: Family farm block straddling the Clayton/Scott town line; about 17 mi from Boscobel. The farmstead is the building at the head of the hollow road in sec. 35 (Clayton): on the 1938 aerial and within about 200 m of the c.1915 plat house dots; other building sites in SW sec. 35 and in sec. 36 are the alternatives. Check LiDAR for old dig holes around them. Permission: private farm, ask first.
